annotation.title_clean: AI Airlock: a regulatory sandbox for AI enabled Medical Devices
annotation.title_en: AI Airlock: a regulatory sandbox for AI enabled Medical Devices
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA)
annotation.summary_en: MHRA web page describing the AI Airlock, the UK's regulatory sandbox for AI-enabled medical devices, covering the pilot, phase 2 and the newly launched phase 3 (post-market surveillance focus), programme reports, workshops and funding. Outputs inform future regulatory guidance for AI medical devices in Great Britain.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI Airlock is MHRA's regulatory sandbox for AI-enabled medical devices, launched 2024.
Phase 3 launched with multi-year DHSC funding, focusing on post-market surveillance and lifecycle oversight.
Pilot and phase 2 involved 11 innovators across 7 regulatory challenges.
Programme reports are not formal guidance but inform a fit-for-purpose regulatory framework.
Outputs fed MHRA's National Commission into the Regulation of AI in Healthcare.
